name: sectors-api
description: Query financial market data from the Sectors API (api.sectors.app) for IDX (Indonesia), SGX (Singapore), and KLSE (Malaysia) markets

interface.shortDescription: Indonesia (IDX), Singapore (SGX), and Malaysia (KLSE) financial data
interface.longDescription: Query Indonesia (IDX), Singapore (SGX), Malaysia (KLSE), and Indonesian mining sector financial data through the Sectors API. Covers stock prices, company reports, financials, market indices, top movers, dividends, earnings, and more.
defaultPrompt: What is the current market cap of BBCA?
Show me the top 5 gainers on IDX this week
Get the quarterly financials for BBRI
Compare P/E ratios of banks in the IDX
What are the top dividend stocks in Singapore?
